source.author: verg
source.text: hic domus Aeneae cunctis dominabitur oris, et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis.
source.text_original: hic domus Aeneae cunctis dominabitur oris, / et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis.'
source.text_english: Here the house of Aeneas shall rule over all shores, and over their sons’ sons, and those who shall be born from them.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Patres autem avos atavosque cognosce et filios filiorum, omnem deinceps sobolem, juxta illud Virgilianum: Et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis: Et senes ergo et habitatores terrae, filiis vestris posterisque narrate; qui senex est, liberos suos doceat sacramenta: qui habitator est terrae, simplicem narret historiam.
reuse.text_original: Patres autem avos atavosque cognosce et filios filiorum, omnem deinceps sobolem, juxta illud Virgilianum: Et nati natorum, et qui nascentur ab illis: Et senes ergo et habitatores terrae, filiis vestris posterisque narrate; qui senex est, liberos suos doceat sacramenta: qui habitator est terrae, simplicem narret historiam.
reuse.text_english: But know your fathers, grandfathers, and great-grandfathers, and the sons of sons, all the offspring in order, according to that line of Virgil: And the children of children, and those who will be born from them. Therefore, both the old and the inhabitants of the earth, tell it to your children and to your descendants; let him who is old teach his own children the mysteries; let him who is an inhabitant of the earth recount the simple story.
